warnings: Last of three pile-cap detail sheets (S-10/S-11/S-12). F10 is used at D2 and F12 at C2 on S-03/หน้า30 — the two most heavily loaded columns. The construction notes common to all six caps are written out on S-10/หน้า37 and not repeated here.

F10 is the only NON-RECTANGULAR cap in the house: its plan is a hexagon (a 1.75 x 1.20 rectangle with the two short ends cut back to points), holding 10 piles in a 3-4-3 arrangement. width_mm/depth_mm are the bounding rectangle 1750 x 1200 — the cut corners are not captured by those two numbers, so the shape is described in the element note instead of being packed into a size field.

F10's plan chain reads 0.20 then six bays of 0.225 then 0.20 = 1.75 across (7 pile columns), and 0.20|0.40|0.40|0.20 = 1.20 deep. F12's reads 0.20|0.45|0.225|0.225|0.45|0.20 = 1.75 across and 0.20|0.45|0.45|0.20 = 1.30 deep, giving 12 piles in a 4x3 grid.

F12's mat is printed as two separate leaders, '8ø12มม.' and '10ø12มม.', not as a single 'n+nø12มม.#' — recorded as a main_bar total of 18 with the two directions itemised in bar_layers. Which leader belongs to which direction is NOT stated on the sheet; assigned 10 bars to the wider 1.75m direction and 8 to the 1.30m direction on the reasonable-but-unconfirmed basis that the larger count spans the larger dimension. Flagged on the element.
Bar-type convention: ø9มม and smaller recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø'.
